entries.text: Sent to Paul, in Antioch (of Syria), from Jerusalem Ac 15:22-34
group: Also called SILVANUS (the long form of the name)

entries.text: Imprisoned with Paul in Philippi Ac 16:19-40
Driven, with Paul, from Thessalonica Ac 17:4-10
Left by Paul at Berea Ac 17:14
Carries Peter’ s letter to Asia Minor 1Pe 5:12
